name: Nekomura Haruka
source:
Akiho's younger sister.
A girl with a bright, energetic personality.

She is full of curiosity and speaks her mind right away.
She is a mood-maker, instantly enlivening the atmosphere wherever she goes.

[Translated from [url=https://shiratamaco.com/kazeshiro/]official website[/url]]
